verdict.rationale: Pigment documents building dashboards and reports (pigment-docs-19, pigment-docs-6) and fine-grained data access rights that control who can see and modify specific data (pigment-docs-15), so users can be given scoped access to the data behind them. However, no evidence describes an actual sharing workflow for dashboards or reports, such as inviting board members or giving viewer-only links. missing for 10: an explicit dashboard/report sharing feature, board or external-viewer access, viewer-role or permission settings at the dashboard level, independent or hands-on corroboration.
